title: Cleaner evidence summaries
details: Evidence previews now keep the learner explanation as the only detailed evidence text
The separate Evidence prompt, Prompt timestamps and Evidence stage blocks have been removed from evidence previews
Exported evidence PDFs use the same cleaner learner-explanation layout and no longer repeat recording prompt timestamps
summary: Evia v227 simplifies evidence previews and PDFs so the learner explanation is the single detailed evidence summary.
